blockingFindings.title: R5 durable surface contents are not exercised
blockingFindings.issue: The R5 test only checks that report-envelope and plugin-hook-output owners are observable and outside the worktree. It does not exercise or assert preservation of the required warning data, plugin hook warning/follow-up data, or recovery envelopes after relocation.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local executable coverage that writes or records finalize-cleanup report warnings, plugin hook warning/follow-up data, and recovery envelope data through the relocated cleanup path, then asserts those caller-visible contents remain available outside the target worktree.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R5 is marked covered, but a required retained surface, especially recovery envelopes and warning/follow-up contents, can be dropped while these tests still pass.

advisoryFindings.title: R4 aggregation test is broad
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider splitting the R4 umbrella test into named cases for metrics relocation, normal worktree removal, and feature branch deletion.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current assertions do cover the listed behaviors, but separate tests would make future coverage drift easier to diagnose.
